prompt.v: A candle starts 92 cm tall and burns down 6 cm every hour. It is now 20 cm tall. How many hours has it burned?

problems.explain: Call the number of hours t. Losing 6 for each one is 6t, taken from the 92: 92 − 6t = 20. Take 20 from 92: 6t = 72. Divide by 6: t = 12.
